scope_note.D_event_microstructure: needs a PIT event calendar overlapping the tick window -> Jin10 calendar exists; new snapshot required for the overlap
scope_note.E_crossmarket_leadlag: needs longer/better PIT cross-market history -> Yahoo 1h/2y DXY+VIX
scope_note.B_execution_alpha: CANNOT be unblocked by calendar/cross-market data: blocker is bid_vol/ask_vol identically 0 (DATA_GAP). Would require L2/queue/fill-probability data, which is a separate availability question (see microstructure_source_audit). This round does NOT unlock B and will not pretend to.

time_fields.observation_time: when the value was OBSERVED (e.g. bar close, tick time)
time_fields.publication_time: when the value was PUBLISHED by the producer
time_fields.availability_time: when the value became USABLE by a point-in-time reader (conservative, >= publication_time)
time_fields.revision_time_vintage: when a value was REVISED; a vintage is the value as known at a given availability_time

status_rule.PASS: BOTH historical observation AND that observation's historical availability/vintage are provable
status_rule.CONDITIONAL: authoritative/snapshot-only, or粒度受限; must state the only admissible granularity
status_rule.FAIL: final values only, no version, no publication time (or client-rendered shell)
status_rule.NOT_AVAILABLE: rate-limit page / error page / no series (payload_verified=false)
status_rule.AUTH_REQUIRED: needs key or OAuth; not a FAIL; do not register, do not borrow third-party app-id

conservative_availability_rules_FROZEN.calendar_event_with_pub_time: available at its own pub_time_utc (no extra lag assumed, no early availability)
conservative_availability_rules_FROZEN.unfinished_bar: FORBIDDEN (never use a bar that had not closed at T)
conservative_availability_rules_FROZEN.intraday_market_bar: available at bar close time (market data; no external publication lag)
conservative_availability_rules_FROZEN.rule_rationale: 宁可晚一天，也不把收盘后才确定的值放到当天盘中
